entries.en: The deed placed the estate under a fee tail.
entries.zh: 契据将这份地产置于限定继承产权之下。

entries.en: The inquiry examined complaints about a strip search.
entries.zh: 调查审查了有关一次脱衣搜查的投诉。

entries.en: The fashion designer pinned fabric onto a dress form.
entries.zh: 时装设计师把布料别在人台上。

entries.en: The memorial records the names of lynching victims.
entries.zh: 纪念碑记载了遭私刑杀害者的姓名。

entries.en: The exhibition traces the dietary ideas behind macrobiotics.
entries.zh: 展览追溯了长寿饮食法背后的饮食理念。

entries.en: The printer's repeated paper jams were maddening.
entries.zh: 打印机反复卡纸，令人气极。

entries.en: An insurance broker explained the differences between the policies.
entries.zh: 一位保险经纪人解释了这些保单之间的差异。

entries.en: The silo stores feed grain for the cattle.
entries.zh: 这座筒仓储存供牛食用的饲料谷物。

entries.en: The baker slid two trays into the gas oven.
entries.zh: 面包师把两个烤盘推进煤气烤炉。

entries.en: The cupboard holds basketball equipment for the school team.
entries.zh: 柜子里存放着校队的篮球器材。

entries.en: The hunters used fresh tracks to track down the boar.
entries.zh: 猎人们利用新鲜足迹追踪到了野猪。

entries.en: A locally made chair stood beside the window.
entries.zh: 一把本地制造的椅子放在窗边。

entries.en: The office handled the mailing of invitation letters.
entries.zh: 办公室负责邀请函的邮寄。

entries.en: The drop hammer shaped the heated metal blank.
entries.zh: 落锤把加热后的金属坯料锻造成形。

entries.en: The lesson explored voting as a civic duty.
entries.zh: 这堂课探讨了作为公民义务的投票。

entries.en: The musicians strike up a march as the parade begins.
entries.zh: 游行开始时，乐手们奏起进行曲。

entries.en: Marketing research revealed why shoppers avoided the new packaging.
entries.zh: 市场调查揭示了顾客为什么不喜欢新包装。

entries.en: We will drop anchor inside the sheltered bay.
entries.zh: 我们将在避风的海湾内抛锚。

entries.en: The operating system uses virtual memory when RAM is scarce.
entries.zh: 操作系统在内存不足时使用虚拟内存。
